AdminAuth.heroBody: Secure access for the Pawelium SUPER_ADMIN: animals, reservations, orders, payments, customers and content.
AdminAuth.heroFootnote: Access is restricted to the single authorised administrator. Every sign-in is recorded in the audit log.
AdminAuth.title: Sign in
AdminAuth.subtitle: Use your SUPER_ADMIN credentials to open the console.
AdminAuth.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your unused recovery codes (format XXXXX-XXXXX).

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Incorrect email or password, or the account is temporarily locked. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes before trying again.
errors.INVALID_CODE: This code is invalid or has already been used.

AdminAuth.forgotSubtitle: Enter the administrator email address. If it matches the account, we will send a single-use reset link.
AdminAuth.resetSent: If this address belongs to the administrator account, a reset link valid for 30 minutes has been sent.
AdminAuth.resetSubtitle: Use at least 12 characters. All existing sessions will be signed out.
AdminAuth.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. Please sign in again.

passwordErrors.TOO_SHORT: The password must contain at least 12 characters.
passwordErrors.MISMATCH: The two passwords do not match.
passwordErrors.INVALID_TOKEN: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
passwordErrors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
